record.edic_text:
3 Abaddon {ab-ad-dohn'}

of Hebrew origin 011; TDNT - 1:4,1; pr n m

AV - Abaddon 1; 1

Abaddon = "destruction"
1) ruin
2) destruction
3) the place of destruction
4) the name of the angel-prince of the infernal regions, the
   minister of death and the author of havoc on the earth
